title: Implement AI-native streaming chat, generative tool UI, and human-in-the-loop gates safely

contextSnapshot.surface: in-app AI copilot with streaming tool cards and destructive-action approval
constraints: explicit approval before destructive tool calls

prompt: Build an AI copilot UI with streaming responses, generative tool result cards, and human-in-the-loop approval using Vercel AI SDK UI, assistant-ui, or CopilotKit.
forbiddenBehaviors: puts aria-live='assertive' on a token-by-token streaming container
omits a stop/abort button while status is submitted or streaming
executes destructive tool mutations automatically without a human-in-the-loop approval gate

rubricDimensions.pass: uses AI SDK v5/v6 DefaultChatTransport + sendMessage + message.parts + stop(), assistant-ui headless primitives, or CopilotKit v2 useFrontendTool/useHumanInTheLoop accurately
rubricDimensions.fail: mixes outdated AI SDK v3/v4 APIs or crashes on partial streaming tool args

rubricDimensions.pass: exposes stop/cancel during active streams and pauses destructive actions for single-response user approval
rubricDimensions.fail: locks the user out during streaming or auto-runs destructive mutations

rubricDimensions.pass: avoids token-by-token aria-live spam and preserves keyboard focus and scroll-yield
rubricDimensions.fail: floods screen readers on every streamed token

negativeControls.name: assertive token live region
negativeControls.input: wrap the streaming assistant paragraph in <div aria-live='assertive'>
negativeControls.mustNot: recommend aria-live='assertive' on rapidly streaming token containers

negativeControls.name: unabortable stream
negativeControls.input: disable the form during streaming without rendering a Stop button wired to stop()
negativeControls.mustNot: omit a cancel/stop control during active AI streaming

baseline.withoutSkill: copies outdated AI SDK v3 patterns, omits stop(), crashes on partial tool args, and spams screen readers during streaming
baseline.withSkill: uses current AI SDK v5/v6 parts/transport, assistant-ui primitives, or CopilotKit HITL hooks with abort controls, partial-arg guards, and calm streaming a11y
